business_summary: Neo Marketing Inc. engages in market support business in Japan. The company offers quantitative survey, such as online and academic research, venue survey, home use tests, in-store and mail survey, customer/employee survey, and demonstration experiment support services; qualitative research, including in-depth interview, group and self-online interview, visiting observation survey, and recruiting; and original services. It also provides strategic planning, such as communication strategy, brand strategy, and strategic PR; survey PR and press release creation and distribution; digital marketing comprising search advertising, display advertising, social media advertising, video ads, content marketing, article writing, pharmaceutical and medical device act check, SNS account management, influencer marketing, and looply services; and creative services. In addition, the company offers customer support, including customer success, telephone support, email and chat support, mystery call/email/chat, SNS direct recruiting; and B2B marketing services. The company was formerly known as Media Interactive Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Neo Marketing Inc. in April 2012. Neo Marketing Inc. was incorporated in 2000 and is headquartered in Shibuya, Japan.
